questions.question: King David and his commanders set apart some sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for what work?

answers.text: Guard the gates of the city

questions.question: Jeduthun, a leader of David's musicians, prophesied with the harp. What was he doing as he played?

answers.text: Giving thanks and praise to the LORD
Warning the king about his enemies
Mourning over the sins of the city

questions.question: God gave Heman, the king's seer, fourteen sons through His promises. What was this meant to do for Heman?
When David's musicians for the house of the LORD cast lots for their duties, the teachers were left out. True or false?
